criterion.closed_chain: A and B use addressed task requests or successive task artifacts, C produces a concrete task result, B reads C output, and A later reads a B-authored task artifact

criterion.handoff: the same unfinished responsibility is exercised by successive holders and the later holder uses the prior holder artifact
